title: Devastator — The Capture of Tantive IV
description: A terraced Imperial-class wedge rising from a razor prow to its stern drives: 18-degree armour tiers, a recessed equatorial trench, an inverted-slope keel, chamfered command decks, eight turbolaser batteries, twin shield globes, and a tractor beam hauling the captured blockade runner into the ventral hangar while two TIEs escort.

sections.name: Bridge tower, shield globes and sensor mast
Three main drives and four auxiliary exhausts
